summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd. (formerly Inspira Technologies) filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, disclosing audited abbreviated financial statements and unaudited pro forma financials related to its previously closed Asset Purchase Agreement on April 6, 2026, with Nano Dimension Ltd.'s Additive Manufacturing Electronics (AME) and Fabrica product lines. The acquisition included specific assets such as intellectual property, equipment, inventory, and customer contracts. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed in this filing. The pro forma statements reflect the combined operations after the close. Watch for integration risks and revenue contributions from the acquired product lines in future earnings reports.
